messages:
morgan_peopleops: FYI  Aisha T (FT, Eng) submitted resignation today. Last official day: 2026-05-15. Key items: COBRA window, benefits termination date, PTO payout calculation, badge deactivation, laptop return (remote), GitHub/org access, and exit interview scheduling. Looping in @harper_hr, @ellie_it, @sam_payroll.

harper_hr: Thanks. For full-time folks COBRA notice is required if eligible. I'll confirm eligibility and provide the formal notice packet. Benefits coverage typically ends last day of the month of termination unless policy states otherwise  I'll verify policy.

devon_manager: I'll collect a 45m handoff with Priya and list active tickets. Aisha says there are two long-running eval jobs; we should snapshot checkpoints.

ellie_it: For remote returns we coordinate courier + UPS label. Please confirm shipping address. After we receive device we'll deprovision Okta, SSO sessions, and VPN certs. We also rotate any service account keys she had access to.

sam_payroll: PTO payout depends on local jurisdiction and hire date. I'll run a quick calc after termination is entered. Final payroll run we aim for 2026-05-22 but could be earlier if paperwork done. COBRA admin will be handled by Benefits Partner; I'll share contact and timelines.

harper_hr: Action items: provide COBRA eligibility + notice, schedule exit interview, confirm last day paperwork. We offer an exit interview and a voluntary separation survey.

offboard-bot: Ticket OFF-4957 created  assignees: ellie_it, sam_payroll, harper_hr. SLA: 4 business days.

ellie_it: Commands I'll run after courier confirmation:
```
# remove from org & list sessions
./bin/org-remove --user aisha.t
okta sessions list --user aisha.t && okta sessions revoke --user aisha.t
# rotate any team service tokens she touched
/secrets/rotate --team inference --user aisha.t
```

ellie_it: We'll keep a 72h grace window post-handoff before hard deprovisioning so managers can confirm no blocked work.

devon_manager: Aishas checklist: handoff doc posted at /shared/handoffs/aisha-hand-off.md, checkpoint snapshots uploaded to S3 (s3://redwood-checkpoints/aisha/). Priya will take over the active evals.

sam_payroll: Preliminary PTO calc: 14.5 days accrued, company payout policy states payout on final paycheck. I'll confirm exact amount and post here once HR confirms termination date.

harper_hr: COBRA note: since Aisha is FT and enrolled in medical, she is eligible. Coverage termination date: last day of 2026-05 (tentative). COBRA window starts after employer notifies admin; I'll send the official packet by EOD Tues.

ellie_it: Security note: security team flagged one long-lived deploy key in repo infra-ops that referenced a personal machine. I'll rotate that key tonight and post the new key owner.

morgan_peopleops: Summary of owners:
- harper_hr: COBRA notice + exit interview (owner)
- ellie_it: device courier + deprovision + key rotation (owner)
- sam_payroll: PTO calc + final payroll (owner)
- devon_manager: handoff + confirm eval snapshot (owner)

offboard-bot: OFF-4957 status updated: device pickup scheduled for 2026-05-18.

harper_hr: Scheduled exit interview: Thu 2026-05-07 09:30 PT. Please add any questions to the doc.

sam_payroll: Confirmed: final payout scheduled for 2026-05-22 payroll pending termination entry. Will post amounts when available.

ellie_it: After we process revocations I'll post timestamps and list of removed access.

morgan_peopleops: Thanks everyone  I'll close OFF-4957 once all tasks show complete and exit survey is recorded.
